additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397125-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002427] allOutletsUnavailable CRM:00921001438
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Thanks for the response.
To answer your previous question: It is not mandatory to reboot the charger after a firmware update, as the charger automatically reboots itself following installation. If there are any active error flags, we try to identify the cause and reboot the charger. This should help clear the active alarms and restore the charger to operational.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397125-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002427] allOutletsUnavailable CRM:00921001438
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek
,
Thanks for the response.
Due to a
Meanbreaker_QA1 closing failure
error that occurred while closing the main breaker, which may have been detected by the time difference between the switch command and the feedback, error flags are automatically reset after a hard reboot.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
